Built and attested by GitHub Actions, and a fix from Obsidian's CSS review. The plugin works as in 0.6.5.

## What changed since 0.6.5

- **Built and attested by GitHub Actions.** 0.6.5 was built on the author's computer while Actions could not run. From this release, `main.js`, `manifest.json` and `styles.css` are built by GitHub Actions from the tagged source, and each carries an artifact attestation of its build provenance. Check a downloaded file with `gh attestation verify main.js --repo Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view`.
- **CSS review fix.** The stylesheet no longer uses `box-decoration-break`, which Obsidian's review reports as only partly supported. The one visible difference: a mark that wraps onto the next line has square corners where the line breaks, not rounded ones. The marks have no padding or border, so nothing else changes.

## The server

Unchanged. The server programs, their checksums and licence files stay on [server-0.6.2](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view/releases/tag/server-0.6.2), so a server you have installed needs nothing.

## Requirements and installation

As in 0.6.5: Obsidian 1.8.7 or later, desktop only, and the model server for your computer. Step by step: [Installation](https://github.com/Gameboard-dev/obsidian-augmented-view/blob/main/docs/installation.md).
